suggested_fix:
One approach:
```
@[simp] theorem arctan_inv_sqrt_three : arctan (√3)⁻¹ = π / 6 := by
  -- reduce to the tan statement
  simpa [inv_eq_one_div] using
    (arctan_eq_of_tan_eq (x := π/6) (y := (√3)⁻¹) tan_pi_div_six
      (by constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos])).symm
```
(or directly `arctan_eq_of_tan_eq tan_pi_div_six ...` if you prefer the equality orientation).
